description: Oak Ridge National Laboratory publishes a Clark County, Nevada extract of AutoBEM building models. Zenodo lists a public 9.45 GB IDF archive and a 160 MB CSV under CC BY 4.0. The provider reports 589,586 residential and commercial buildings, with county and state, climate zone, estimated construction year and type, centroid, footprint, conditioned area and other building descriptors. The IDFs can be used to simulate individual building energy demand before aggregation to electricity-grid cells or urban-heat studies. The related catalogue Model America record covers the national source; this named county extract has its own files and DOI. A separate deposit of 129 Clark County archetypes and 120 multipliers is a smaller derived representation. A limitation is that AutoBEM infers many attributes from geospatial data and prototypes, not audits. Zenodo warns that model multipliers and files may be updated. No IDF archive or CSV was downloaded, and model counts, identifiers and EnergyPlus outputs were not checked.
